request.text:
Ticket (personal data masked):
The print queue is stuck. Nothing has printed from my laptop NW-LT-2207 since this morning and I need to print board papers before 2pm.

Employee: Financial Analyst, Finance, London; ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 (Windows 11).

Why FixProof stopped: Fix script is in scope: malicious: security blinding or EDR evasion.

What FixProof already did: screened the ticket and masked personal data; classified it as printing, high severity; searched the knowledge base and kept 1 passage; drafted a reply and verified it (99% grounded); inspected the powershell script: malicious.

Verified holding reply sent to the employee:
To resolve the stuck print queue, please follow these steps:
1. Open Settings > Bluetooth & devices > Printers & scanners, select the printer and choose Open print queue.
2. Cancel all documents, then try printing a test page
